purpose: Owner-pending governance findings, one entry each, dated. Read by tests/conformance/sas-governance.test.ts (an accepted SAS revision needs a signed response OR an entry here) and by scripts/war-check-gate.mjs (the CI job that runs `war check --generated`: an ERROR is tolerated only when an entry here names its rule and file, and not after review_by). An entry whose finding no longer occurs fails both, so this list cannot outlive what it excuses. It is never a blanket ignore: there is no wildcard, and a rule is excused only for the one file named.

entries.subject: SAS-0.1.0-draft.4
entries.reason: 0.1.0-draft.4 is recorded as accepted in its revision file, and no signed oh.war/sas-acceptance-response/v1 exists under docs/authority/responses/. Signing is the owner's act (`war sign SAS-0.1.0-draft.4 --ssh-sign`); no agent performs it, so the finding stays visible here until the owner signs or withdraws the acceptance.
